title: Petition of Algonquin Gas Transmission Company requesting authority for the Department of Public Utilities to take by eminent domain under G.L. c. 79 and c. 164, such rights of way, easements or other interests in land, or other property as may be necessary and have not been previously acquired, for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration and removal of said natural gas transmissin pipelines and appurtenant facilities situated in the Towns of Seekonk and Plymouth along the respective routes of lines G-5 and G-8L.
